decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

26.EST 00 001 Rev 03 Site Plan dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 01 001 Rev 03 Plans Existing dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 01 002 Rev 03 Plans Existing Copy 1 dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 01 005 Rev 05 Plans Proposed dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 01 006 Rev 04 Plans Proposed Copy 1 dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 02 001 Rev 03 Elevations ex dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 02 002 Rev 03 Elevation side ex dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 02 005 Rev 05 Elevations Pr dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 02 006 Rev 04 Elevations side Pr dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 02 007 Rev 03 Window details Existing and Proposed dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 03 001 Rev 03 Sections Existing dated 10/09/2026; 26.EST 03 002 Rev 04 Sections Proposed dated 10/09/2026; Conservation Box Sash Window Standard Specification Rev D dated 24/05/2023; Conservation Balcony Doors Rev F dated 16/03/2023; VELUX Cross section dimensions dated 29/07/2026; VA-028 Rev 001 Product Specification Guide Fixed & Opening Luxlite dated 16/10/2019; 26.EST R02 Design & Access Statement dated 19/08/2026; 26.EST MATERIALS (no date).

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external facing materials shall be as specified in the approved materials schedule 26.EST MATERIALS received 31/08/2026 and the approved drawings including natural slate roof tiles, zinc cladding to the rear dormer and white-painted timber to the replacement windows.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Rooflights RL1 and RL3 shall be flush conservation-style rooflights.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Erection of a dormer within the rear roofslope, replacement of existing concrete roof tiles with slate tiles, replacement of existing single-glazed timber sash windows at first, second and third-floor levels and the second-floor rear terrace door with double-glazed units, repositioning and enlargement of one existing rooflight on the front and rear roofslope, installation of a walk-on rooflight and glazed lantern at rear terrace level, removal of the existing first-floor rear garden balcony and installation of a metal planter tray and associated works.
